public_objects.name: ALGO_VERSION
public_objects.value: 2 (CHANGED from 1: recomputes complete runs on the next finish replay)

files.role: Pure implementation of HR1 (validity) and HRR1 (recovery metrics + curve). No database, no clock. Imported by metrics.py (so it must not import metrics.py: inputs are plain (timestamp, bpm) tuples).

methods.name: valid_hr_points
methods.purpose: Apply HR1 (range check, then isolated-spike rule) to time-ordered points; returns the valid points; never alters values.

methods.name: compute_recovery
methods.purpose: HRR1: returns {hr_end, hr_60, hr_120, hrr60, hrr120, curve} where the scalars are float|None and curve is [[t_s_since_run_finished_at, bpm], ...]; points = all raw HR samples of the run (running + recovery), unfiltered.

files.role: A1 plus RS2 clipping and the recovery object. Usages of changed symbols found by grep: compute_metrics (metrics.recompute_and_store, tests/test_metrics.py:21), recompute_and_store (routers/native.py x2, fit_import.py:135, tests/test_metrics.py:81,85), MetricsResult (metrics.py only).

methods.name: __init__
methods.purpose: CHANGED: adds recovery (None when run_finished_at is None).

methods.name: compute_metrics
methods.purpose: CHANGED: when run_finished_at is set, drop locations and heart rates with ts > run_finished_at before A1 (RS2) and compute recovery via recovery.compute_recovery using finished_at as training end; when None behave exactly as ALGO_VERSION 1. finished_at None with run_finished_at set -> recovery None.

methods.name: recompute_and_store
methods.purpose: CHANGED: also loads runs.run_finished_at and runs.finished_at, passes them to compute_metrics, and upserts run_metrics.recovery (pass Json(obj) for an object, plain None for SQL NULL; never Json(None)).

Pure, Android-free HR1 validity + HR2 display smoothing. Constants have the same names/values as backend/config.py (HR_VALID_MIN_BPM, HR_VALID_MAX_BPM, HR_SPIKE_MAX_BPM_PER_S) plus the phone-only ones below; validity parity is verified with recovery_golden.json.

methods.name: constructor
methods.purpose: One raw HR reading (timestamp = sample timestamp, UTC epoch ms).

methods.name: constructor
methods.purpose: Display value; bpm null = gap (never 0).

public_objects.name: HrConfig
public_objects.value: object: VALID_MIN_BPM=30, VALID_MAX_BPM=230, SPIKE_MAX_BPM_PER_S=40.0 (same as backend/config.py); ROLLING_5S_S=5.0, ROLLING_10S_S=10.0, RAW_TOLERANCE_S=2.0 (HR_RAW_TOLERANCE_S), GAP_BREAK_S=5.0 (HR_GAP_BREAK_S), RECAP_BUCKET_S=1.0 (HR_RECAP_BUCKET_S)

methods.name: validSamples
methods.purpose: HR1 on time-ordered samples: range check then isolated-spike rule; returns the valid ones unchanged.

methods.name: valueAt
methods.purpose: HR2 value at a time: mean of valid samples in the mode's window (trailing (t-n,t] or centered); RAW = nearest valid sample within RAW_TOLERANCE_S; null when no valid sample (never 0).

methods.name: series
methods.purpose: One point per input sample, centered window; RAW = the sample's own bpm if valid else null; null where the window has no valid sample.

methods.name: isGap
methods.purpose: True when the time between consecutive samples exceeds GAP_BREAK_S (charts break the line).

methods.purpose: Append a reading (readings with bpm < 1 are kept raw, HR1 decides validity later).

methods.name: snapshot
methods.purpose: RecoveryMetrics.compute with trainingEnd = nowMillis; lastHr = newest reading not older than A1.LIVE_HR_STALE_MS else null; reminderDue = now - runFinishedAt >= REMINDER_MS.

files.role: Pure assembly of RecapData (flow step build_recap). Running-phase clipping at runFinishedAtMillis for splits/maxHr; hrSeries over all given HR.

methods.name: build
